audit_findings.magnitude: FY2025 distributions were $50.097 million and stakes_net is $229.9 million; the entire bridge add-back equals $0.40 per share, while removing all FY2025 distributions from the anchor would reduce computed bull value by approximately $1.31 per share
audit_findings.mechanism: Equity-method distributions can enter cash-based OE while the same ownership interests are added through stakes_net in the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: Distributions received are reflected in Operating Activities in the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows unless the cumulative distributions exceed the portion of the cumulative equity in earnings of the equity method investment.
audit_findings.explanation: Double counting is possible but not demonstrated because the OE reconciliation does not show which investee distributions were removed. Even the conservative scale of treating all filed distributions as duplicated produces an effect well below the $4.62 per-share gap between market price and bull value, so it cannot change the conclusion that the shares exceed modeled value.
audit_findings.action: Map the $229.9 million stakes_net to Garudafood and Joy Topco, trace investee distributions through every OE year, and rerun after removing either the relevant distributions from OE or the corresponding stake value, but not both.

audit_findings.title: The Justin’s transaction may break perimeter coherence
audit_findings.magnitude: $125 million preliminary enterprise value, $75.8 million cash proceeds, and $46.3 million retained-interest fair value; $125 million equals approximately $0.22 per share
audit_findings.mechanism: FY2025 OE includes the formerly consolidated business, while the July 2026 bridge can include sale proceeds and the separately recorded 49% retained equity-method interest.
audit_findings.evidence: Subsequent to the end of the fiscal year, the Company announced a definitive agreement to sell a 51 % controlling position in the Justin’s ® business to Forward Consumer Partners, LLC based on a preliminary enterprise value of $ 125 million.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter mismatch is demonstrated: the sale closed on December 15, 2025, before the bridge date, and the retained interest was recorded separately. Justin’s operating OE is not disclosed, but the filed transaction scale is only about $0.22 per share versus the $4.62 market-price premium to bull value, so it is not reasonably capable of reversing the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Remove Justin’s consolidated OE from the anchor, confirm the $75.8 million proceeds are present in bridge cash, retain the $46.3 million Joy Topco interest only once, and rerun the scenarios on the post-sale perimeter.

audit_findings.title: Unfunded benefit obligations are absent from the equity bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $176.617 million net pension and postretirement deficit at FY2025 year-end and $301 million of filed ten-year unfunded-plan payments, equal to approximately $0.31 and $0.53 per share, respectively
audit_findings.mechanism: An unrecognized benefit deficit would reduce the equity bridge unless its future funding is already captured in projected cash-based OE.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company expects to make contributions of $ 30.2 million during fiscal 2026, which represent benefit payments for unfunded plans.
audit_findings.explanation: The absence of a bridge deduction is demonstrated, but an overstatement is not: operating cash flow already reflects employer funding, creating a possible double deduction if the deficit is also subtracted. Even the undiscounted $301 million payment total is only $0.53 per share, far below the $4.62 price-to-bull gap.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile plan assets, current benefit liabilities, and noncurrent benefit liabilities at July 26, 2026; identify benefit payments already embedded in OE; deduct only the after-tax deficit not otherwise captured and rerun the bridge.

audit_findings.title: Gross cash add-back may include tax-affected or operating foreign cash
audit_findings.magnitude: $224 million of foreign cash and $868.446 million total cash and short-term investments; approximately $0.39 and $1.53 per share, respectively
audit_findings.mechanism: The bridge adds cash and short-term investments at gross carrying value even when balances may be operationally required or subject to repatriation leakage.
audit_findings.evidence: During the third quarter of fiscal 2025, the Company repatriated $44 million in cash from an international subsidiary and recognized foreign withholding taxes on the one-time distribution.
audit_findings.explanation: The amount of restricted or required cash and the withholding-tax rate are unresolved. Nevertheless, even excluding the entire $868.446 million add-back would reduce bull value only from $16.92 to approximately $15.39 per share, leaving it well below the $21.54 market price.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the July 2026 cash-by-jurisdiction schedule, minimum operating-cash analysis, and applicable withholding taxes; rerun the bridge using only distributable excess cash net of leakage.

audit_findings.title: The anchor may contain a temporary inventory cash-flow drag
audit_findings.magnitude: $172 million filed FY2025 inventory increase; under the stated MIN(trend, latest) policy, the anchor can rise only $53.2 million to the supplied $627 million trend, increasing computed base and bull values by approximately $1.24 and $1.39 per share
audit_findings.mechanism: A temporary inventory build depresses cash-based OE, but the valuation policy caps a normalized latest-year anchor at the lower trend estimate.
audit_findings.evidence: In fiscal 2025, inventory increased $172 million primarily due to higher raw material costs, strategic inventory build for certain categories, and recovery of snack nuts inventory levels following the production disruptions at the Suffolk, Virginia manufacturing facility.
audit_findings.explanation: The cash outflow is demonstrated, but its temporary portion is unresolved because it includes higher raw-material costs as well as rebuilding and strategic inventory. Even treating enough of the increase as temporary to lift latest OE above trend leaves the anchor capped at $627 million and bull value near $18.31, still below the $21.54 price.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the $172 million increase by inflation, normal volume, strategic build, and disruption recovery; rerun the anchor and scenarios only for the evidenced temporary portion while preserving the MIN(trend, latest) rule.

audit_findings.title: A favorable legal settlement may remain in recurring owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $11.0 million pre-tax and $8.312 million after tax; approximately $0.19 per share of computed base value or $0.22 per share of computed bull value
audit_findings.mechanism: If retained in FY2025 cash-based OE, the one-time settlement receipt is capitalized as recurring OE and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company recorded a gain of $ 11.0 million in Selling, General, and Administrative during the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025 in connection with the settlement of a legal matter.
audit_findings.explanation: Retention in the anchor is not demonstrated because the OE reconciliation was not supplied. If fully retained, removing the filed after-tax benefit would lower modeled value by no more than about $0.22 per share, immaterial against the $4.62 market-price premium to bull value.
audit_findings.action: Trace the $11 million receipt through operating cash flow and the OE adjustments; remove the $8.312 million after-tax benefit if retained and apply the same policy to adverse one-time legal cash costs.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $25.8 million in FY2020, equal to approximately 2.8% of FY2020 OE of $929.3 million
audit_findings.mechanism: Residual D&A is left as an OE expense rather than added back; it affects the historical series but not the FY2025 latest-actual anchor directly.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2020 $25.8m (12.5% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: This is a disclosed conservative treatment, not a demonstrated overstatement. The identified uncertainty is confined to FY2020 and represents only 2.8% of that year's OE; the valuation anchors to FY2025 rather than the higher trend, so the residual cannot materially change the present conclusion on the supplied record.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the FY2020 fixed-asset and amortization composition, classify the $25.8 million residual, and rerun the historical trend only if filed evidence identifies eligible non-economic charges.
